text.en:
The balance remaining unexpended on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-six, of the
sum of thirty thousand pesos appropriated by section one, subsection (x), item five, of Act Numbered
Thirty-two hundred and thirteen, known as the Public Works Act of nineteen hundred and twenty-five, as
amended by section one of Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and fifty-six, for the maintenance and
improvement of the port works and wharf of Capiz, Province of Capiz, is hereby reappropriated for the same

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1926.
